statement: Interventions that push Batch Sharpness past its operating plateau (larger lr or momentum, smaller batch) trigger sharp loss 'catapults' (Figure 6).

interventions.config: INTERVENE decrease batch  SGDM eta=0.1 b=4
INTERVENE increase beta   SGDM eta=0.1 beta=0.98 b=64
INTERVENE increase lr     SGDM eta=0.3 b=64

mutation_test: A run with smaller lr (eta=0.05, b=64) stays INSIDE the operating plateau and shows no catapult (final loss 0.008711), confirming the catapult is caused by exceeding -- not merely by changing -- the plateau.
note: Empirical Figure-6 claim. The catapult mechanism (loss explodes once Batch Sharpness exceeds its operating plateau) is reproduced on the synthetic MLP; the exact CIFAR-10 intervention curves of the paper are unavailable here.
